title: Apple/macOS silently removed from official Unix registry
summary: Apple silently removed macOS from The Open Group's official UNIX® Certified Products registry, ending its status as a formally Unix-compliant operating system. This marks a significant shift as macOS had maintained Unix certification since OS X 10.5, and the removal went unnoticed for some time.
problem_solved: Reports on the removal of macOS from Unix certification, raising questions about future compatibility guarantees for Unix-dependent applications and development workflows.
why_valuable: Important for developers relying on Unix compliance for software deployment, as the certified status previously assured POSIX compatibility and system-level consistency across Unix-like environments.
